info.title: ae/sound-cues
info.description: Sounds for events. A manifest names the sound files (cues) and says which cues each event plays and when; sound is on or off by the device's sound preference (the preferences component's sound value). Web: implementation/web/cue-model.ts and cues.ts (Web Audio). Apple: SoundCueModel and SoundCuePlayer (AVFoundation). Android: CueModel, ManifestJson and SoundCuePlayer (SoundPool) in package ae.sound.

methods.name: manifestPath
methods.description: The manifest's path for the soundManifest setting: <folder>/manifest.json. Swift: SoundCueModel.manifestPath(_:) throws SoundCueError.invalid. Kotlin: CueModel.manifestPath(soundManifest) throws IllegalArgumentException.

errors.message: soundManifest must be a folder name of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens: <value>

methods.name: normaliseSettings
methods.description: The settings with defaults filled in, checked. Web only.

errors.message: soundManifest must be a folder name of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens: <value>
defaultMuted must be true or false

methods.name: isSafeFile
methods.description: True when a value is a SoundFile. Swift: SoundCueModel.isSafeFile(_:). Kotlin: CueModel.isSafeFile(file).

methods.name: validateManifest
methods.description: One message per problem in a manifest; an empty list means it is usable. Swift: part of SoundCueModel.parseManifest. Kotlin: CueModel.validate(manifest) on a parsed SoundManifest.

methods.name: parseManifest
methods.description: Parses and checks manifest text. Swift: SoundCueModel.parseManifest(_: Data) throws SoundCueError.notJSON or .invalid(problems). Kotlin: ManifestJson.parse(text) throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: eventPlan
methods.description: What an event plays, with delays filled in; an event that is itself a cue name with no entry of its own plays that cue at once; any other unknown name plays nothing. Swift: SoundCueModel.eventPlan(_:_:). Kotlin: CueModel.eventPlan(manifest, event).

methods.name: cueFiles
methods.description: Every file the manifest uses, in cue order, for loading ahead of time. Web only; Swift SoundManifest.cueNames lists the cue names sorted.

methods.name: fileUrl
methods.description: baseUrl (trailing slashes dropped) joined to a safe file. Web only; Swift locates files with the locate function given to SoundCuePlayer, Kotlin as raw resources.

methods.name: rawResourceName
methods.description: The Android raw resource name for a file: prefix plus its base name in lower case with other characters as underscores (tap.wav is snd_tap). Swift: SoundCueModel.rawResourceName(_:prefix:). Kotlin: CueModel.rawResourceName(file, prefix).

methods.name: isMuted
methods.description: Muted is the opposite of the device's sound preference; with no recorded preference defaultMuted decides. Swift: SoundCueModel.isMuted(sound:defaultMuted:). Kotlin: CueModel.isMuted(sound, defaultMuted).

params.name: sound
params.description: The preference; null or absent when none is recorded.

methods.name: soundPreferenceDefault
methods.description: The default to give the preferences component for sound: the opposite of defaultMuted. Swift: SoundCueModel.soundPreferenceDefault(defaultMuted:). Kotlin: CueModel.soundPreferenceDefault(defaultMuted).

methods.name: createCues
methods.description: A player for a manifest. Nothing plays before unlock has run once (browsers allow sound only after a tap); sounds load when first needed, may overlap, and all stop when sound is turned off. Muted follows the preferences' sound value, or is kept in memory without preferences. Swift: SoundCuePlayer(manifest:locate:isMuted:allowed:maxPerCue:) on the main actor. Kotlin: SoundCuePlayer(manifest, isMuted, allowed, maxStreams) then init(context, resolveRaw) and release() when done.

errors.message: soundManifest must be a folder name of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens: <value>
defaultMuted must be true or false

methods.name: Cues.unlock
methods.description: Creates and resumes the audio context; call from a tap. Called on the player createCues returns. Web only.

methods.name: Cues.unlockOn
methods.description: Unlocks on the first event of type (default pointerdown) on the target while sound is allowed. Called on the player createCues returns. Web only.

methods.name: Cues.play
methods.description: Plays one cue after delayMs unless muted, not allowed, unknown or not unlocked. Called on the player createCues returns. Swift: play(_:delayMs:). Kotlin: play(cue, delayMs) with whole milliseconds.

methods.name: Cues.emit
methods.description: Plays what the manifest says the event plays (eventPlan). Called on the player createCues returns. Swift: emit(_:). Kotlin: emit(event).

methods.name: Cues.preload
methods.description: Loads every cue's sound once unlocked. Called on the player createCues returns. Web only; the native players prepare on first use (Kotlin: init).

schema.description: Resolves when every sound has loaded or failed.

methods.name: Cues.stopAll
methods.description: Stops everything playing or waiting. Called on the player createCues returns. Swift and Kotlin: stopAll().

methods.name: Cues.muted
methods.description: Whether sound is muted now. Called on the player createCues returns. Web only; the native players call the isMuted function they were given.

methods.name: Cues.setMuted
methods.description: Writes the preference's sound value (the opposite of muted), or the in-memory value without preferences; muting stops everything. Called on the player createCues returns. Web only.

methods.name: Cues.onMutedChange
methods.description: Calls the listener whenever muted changes; returns a function that removes it. Called on the player createCues returns. Web only.

schema.description: A function supplied by the caller: (muted: boolean) => void. It is called, not serialised.
A function supplied by the caller: () => void. It is called, not serialised.

methods.name: Cues.active
methods.description: How many cues are playing or waiting. Called on the player createCues returns. Web only.

Name.description: A cue or event name: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at most 48.

SoundFile.description: A path relative to the manifest's folder, without .. or //, ending in wav, mp3, ogg, m4a, aac or caf.

ManifestStep.description: A cue name, or a cue with a delay in milliseconds.

cues.description: Cue name to file; no two cues share a file (compared without case).

events.description: Event name to the cues it plays, in order; every step names a cue in cues.

Manifest.description: The folder's manifest.json. Swift: SoundManifest (cues, events of CueStep). Kotlin: SoundManifest(cues, events).

soundManifest.description: The folder holding manifest.json and the sound files (an aepm string setting cannot hold a path).

defaultMuted.description: Whether sound starts muted when the device has no recorded preference.

SoundSettings.description: The installer settings; DEFAULT_SETTINGS is sounds, false.

Preferences.description: The preferences component's store, as far as sound goes: get('sound') returns a boolean, set('sound', value), subscribe(listener(name, value)) returns an unsubscribe function.

AudioContext.description: A Web Audio AudioContext or an object with state, currentTime, destination, resume(), decodeAudioData(data) and createBufferSource().

EventTarget.description: An object with addEventListener(type, listener, options), such as document.

baseUrl.description: Where the manifest's files are served from, such as ./sounds.

allowed.description: A function supplied by the caller: () => boolean; false stops all sound for now, such as on a shared display. It is called, not serialised.

createContext.description: A function supplied by the caller: () => AudioContext. It is called, not serialised.

fetchFile.description: A function supplied by the caller: (url: string) => Promise<ArrayBuffer>. It is called, not serialised.

Cues.description: The player createCues returns; its operations are the Cues.* methods.
